sentences.text: Starrcade was an annual professional wrestling event , originally broadcast via closed-circuit television and eventually broadcast via pay-per-view television , held from 1983 to 2000 by the National Wrestling Alliance -LRB- NWA -RRB- and later World Championship Wrestling -LRB- WCW -RRB- .	professional wrestling	professional wrestling	National Wrestling Alliance	National Wrestling Alliance	World Championship Wrestling	World Championship Wrestling	closed-circuit television	closed-circuit television	pay-per-view	pay-per-view

Starrcade was regarded by the NWA and WCW as their flagship event of the year , much in the same vein that its rival , the World Wrestling Entertainment , regards WrestleMania .	World Wrestling Entertainment	WWE	WrestleMania	WrestleMania
As a result , the buildup to each Starrcade featured the largest feuds of the promotion .	feuds	Feud (professional wrestling)

From 1983 to 1987 , Starrcade was produced by Jim Crockett Promotions -LRB- JCP -RRB- , the dominant promotion of the NWA , and aired on Thanksgiving Day .	Jim Crockett Promotions	Jim Crockett Promotions	Thanksgiving Day	Thanksgiving (United States)

In 1987 , the WWF scheduled a pay-per-view of their own , Survivor Series , on Thanksgiving night and demanded exclusivity from cable providers on carriage of the event .	Survivor Series	Survivor Series (1987)	pay-per-view	pay-per-view

In order to prevent such a problem , Starrcade was moved to December the following year and the show was held around Christmas Day , mostly in the days following , beginning in 1988 .	Christmas Day	Christmas Day	Christmas	Christmas
Also in 1988 , JCP was sold to Turner Broadcasting due to financial problems and became WCW , though Starrcade was held under the NWA banner until 1990 .	Turner Broadcasting	Turner Broadcasting

From the 1960s to the 1980s , it was tradition for JCP to hold major professional wrestling events on Thanksgiving and Christmas , mostly at Greensboro Coliseum .	professional wrestling	professional wrestling	Christmas	Christmas	Greensboro Coliseum	Greensboro Coliseum

In 1983 , JCP created Starrcade as their supercard to continue the Thanksgiving tradition , and spread it across its territory on closed-circuit television .	supercard	Card (sports)	closed-circuit television	closed-circuit television
It popularized broadcasting on closed-circuit television and was financially successful .	closed-circuit television	closed-circuit television
From 1987 , Starrcade was broadcast on pay-per-view , the first NWA event to do so .	pay-per-view	pay-per-view
The rights to the event now belong to WWE -LRB- formerly the World Wrestling Federation -RRB- .
In November 2008 , WWE 24/7 Classics aired a special as a celebration of the 25th anniversary of the event called The Essential Starrcade .
This five-part series counts down the top 25 matches in Starrcade history .
In January 2009 , WWE Home Video released Starrcade : The Essential Collection as a three disc DVD set .	WWE Home Video	WWE Home Video	DVD	DVD
With the launch of the WWE Network in 2014 all Starrcade shows became available on demand to Network subscribers .	WWE Network	WWE Network
